3B.  (1)  Every  notary  public  who  attests  a
deed  or  instrument  in  terms  of  the  Notaries
Ordinance in respect of a transaction referred
to in section 3A of this Act, shall –

(a)
examine the relevant volumes and
folios  in  the  Registrar  General’s
department;

(b)
be  satisfied  that  the  power  of
attorney  has  not  been  revoked  or
cancelled  and  shall  state  such  fact
in his attestation; and

(c)
retain  the  copies  of  the  National
Identity Card or the driving license
or  the  bio  page  of  the  passport,  as
the case may be, of the grantor and
the attorney, and a copy of the power
of attorney.
(2) For the avoidance of doubt, it is declared
that it shall be sufficient for the notary public
who attests such deed or instrument to examine
the  relevant  volumes  and  the  folios  in  the
Registrar  General’s  department  in  order  to
determine whether such power of attorney has
been revoked or cancelled.
